company_name: UAL Corporation / United Air Lines, Inc.

instrument_type_details.notes: Complex portfolio: calls, collars, 3-way collars, 4-way collars, purchased puts. 2009 full-year 34% hedged: 9% calls (5,350k bbls at $81/bbl and $106/bbl), 5% collars (3,450k calls / 2,775k puts), 18% 3-way collars (12,525k calls / 10,350k puts / 10,350k floor puts), 2% 4-way collars, plus 17% purchased puts protecting short put positions (9,500k bbls at $54/bbl). Q1 2009 50% hedged. Crude oil equivalent pricing. Company was under severe financial stress from $965M collateral posted to counterparties. Some sold puts had 2x notional of purchased calls.

warnings: Massive hedge loss year: fair value dropped from +$20M at Dec 31, 2007 to -$867M at Dec 31, 2008 due to fuel price spike then crash
Company posted $965M in cash collateral to counterparties as of Dec 31, 2008
Volumes disclosed in barrels (thousands), not gallons - conversions not done as pct-of-consumption already given
Complex structure with ratios: some 3-way/collar sold puts had 2x notional of purchased calls
Expected 2009 cash hedge losses of ~$297M classified in non-operating expense
Company also purchased puts in 2008 to cap losses on short put positions from further oil price decreases
Less than 1% of 2010 fuel consumption hedged at Dec 31, 2008
